pluginApiHover.doc: Docusaurus entry point: registers the theme components and wires the index and runtime config into the client bundle.

validateOptions.doc: Validates the plugin options; the site mixes this into its own joi schema.

rehypeApiHover.doc: Rehype pass that stamps data-api-id onto prose mentions of API symbols at build time.

apiHover.doc: Astro integration for Blume and plain Astro sites: annotates in the browser and runs the framework-free hover runtime. The hovers on this site run through it.

initApiHover.doc: Browser entry injected on every page: loads the names JSON, annotates the DOM, and wires the tooltip listeners.

buildApiHoverIndex.doc: Builds the resolution index from the names JSON: id set, short-name map, member map, and base map.

getSnippetContext.doc: Parses a Python snippet once into its import aliases, inferred locals, and bound names.

resolveApiName.doc: Resolves a dotted name through import aliases first, then a globally-unique short name.

resolveMember.doc: Finds a member's defining id on a class, walking documented base classes.

resolveProseMention.doc: Resolves a prose mention: an exact dotted name, a unique dotted suffix, or a unique bare name.

resolveDotted.sig: resolveDotted(name, aliases, locals, binds, index): string | undefined
resolveDotted.doc: Resolves one dotted occurrence in a snippet, using inferred local types for member access.

annotateLines.doc: Annotates one prism-rendered line: each identifier piece gets apiId when it resolves against the index.

isAnnotatedLanguage.doc: Whether code blocks in this prism language get annotated.

ApiHoverIndex.doc: The resolution index: ids, id set, short-name map, member and base maps, and prefer prefixes.

SnippetContext.doc: Binding context for one snippet: import aliases, inferred locals, and bound names.

PrismToken.doc: One prism token; annotateLines sets apiId on identifier pieces that resolve.

PluginOptions.doc: Options the Docusaurus plugin entry takes: dataFile, infoUrl, preferPrefixes, languages.

RehypeApiHoverOptions.doc: Options the rehype pass takes: dataFile, preferPrefixes, apiBasePath.

ApiHoverAstroOptions.doc: Options the Astro integration takes: namesUrl, infoUrl, preferPrefixes, languages.

dataFile.doc: Path to the generated names JSON, relative to the site directory. Required.

infoUrl.doc: URL the runtime fetches the info JSON from, with the index version appended as a cache buster.

namesUrl.doc: URL the browser fetches the names JSON from on Astro sites.

preferPrefixes.doc: Id prefixes that win a short-name collision, so secondary id sources never change an annotation.

languages.doc: Language modules to enable for code annotation. Built in: python.

apiBasePath.doc: Docs base path under which symbol pages live; the rehype pass uses it to recognize API links.
